product_designer.headline: Fourteen months in, portfolio carries the proof
product_designer.why: A designer's CV is read next to a portfolio, so it must not try to be one. The link sits in the header, the case studies get one line each, and the page is spent on what she owned, the method she used and what changed. The portfolio shows how it looked; only the CV can say what it did.
